title: Juniper and the Orbit
author: Gideon Kavanagh
blurb: Orsen Eriksen, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
